n52ff2c03ba.headline: UK economy suffers shock 0.2pc contraction pre-Brexitin second quarter
n52ff2c03ba.summary: The UK economy experienced a 0.2% contraction in the second quarter, indicating a slowdown before Brexit. This impacts investor sentiment and economic outlook.
n52ff2c03ba.why: A GDP contraction signals economic slowdown, affecting currency, bond yields, and market confidence in the UK.
n52ff2c03ba.why_moved: UK GDP contraction reduces investor confidence, likely causing a decline in UK equities and currency.

n62d5220b45.headline: Egypt’s headline inflation drops to 4-year low of 8.7%, core inflation retreats to 5.9%  in July
n62d5220b45.summary: Egypt's headline inflation fell to 8.7%, with core inflation retreating to 5.9%, following fuel subsidy reductions and price hikes.
n62d5220b45.why: Inflation levels affect consumer purchasing power, monetary policy, and economic stability in Egypt.

ndb25068d44.headline: US Open – Italy, UK GDP, Gold, Oil
ndb25068d44.summary: Markets decline amid Italian political instability, with US equity futures also expected to open lower due to regional woes.
ndb25068d44.why: Italian political instability affects European markets and investor sentiment globally, influencing US market opening directions.
ndb25068d44.why_moved: Political uncertainty in Italy increases risk aversion, leading to declines in European indices and affecting global market sentiment.
